text:
alex: We should add explainability hooks to the routing policy engine — SREs and PMs keep asking why requests pick a particular region/tier/model. Quick thoughts?
maria: +1. We need a lightweight human-readable rationale per decision. Not full logs, just reason codes + normalized scores.
sam: Agree but worry about per-request bloat. Can we do sampled explainability or an on-demand explain endpoint instead of always-inlined payloads?
dmitri: Sampling + trace-linking sounds good. My suggestion: emit a short header like `X-Routing-Explain: reason=cost;cost_score=0.62;lat_score=0.18;affinity=0.45;trace_id=abcd1234` for 10% of requests, full explanation in trace/logs.
lisa: Another option: attach a small decision_id token (opaque) that references a stored artifact in our decision-store. That keeps request size tiny and lets us evolve the schema without client churn.
maria: Example payload (for diagnostics):
```json
{
  "decision_id": "dec-2024-06-12-000123",
  "primary_reasons": ["cost","latency"],
  "scores": {"cost": 0.62, "latency": 0.18, "affinity": 0.45},
  "fallback_chain": ["model-v2-quant","model-v1"],
  "policy_version": "pol-42",
  "slice": "frontend-embeddings"
}
```
sam: That's clean. We still need to decide retention and PII — decision blobs could include tenant ids, geo, etc. storage policy matters.
security-bot: Flag: decision blobs that contain tenant identifiers or input prefixes may be PII under some regs. Recommend default redaction and per-customer opt-in for full payloads.
dmitri: Also consider two-level approach: "fast explain" inline (small scores + codes) + "deep explain" via trace/decision-store accessible to infra & on-call. Keep default low overhead.
alex: UX question: what do we show in Console? Inline header is opaque. If we surface to Console we should map reason codes to human text and link to the decision view.
lisa: Implementation concerns: decision-store needs to be cheap/high-QPS for lookups during debugging. We can TTL entries for 7-30 days and archive rollups for evals.
maria: For rollout: 1) add header + decision_id, 2) enable sampling flag 10%, 3) wire trace -> decision-store write, 4) Console UI to resolve decision_id to human view.
sam: Canary suggestion: enable sampled explain for one region and one tenant group for 48h, check latency p50/p95 and payload sizes.
dmitri: Open question: should policy engine return the top-k scored alternatives to help debug "near ties"? That might be helpful but increases write size. Maybe only include top-1 id + optional top-k in deep explain.
alex: Action items: maria + dmitri own spec for header schema + decision-store API. sam to run perf bench on extra header vs decision_id. lisa to draft retention/archival plan and security-bot to finalize redaction rules. I'll schedule a quick 30m sync after the spec draft.
maria: I'll put a short RFC in docs and include examples and small breaking notes for clients. Will also add examples for SDKs to expose the header as metadata.
ops-bot: noted: created ticket INF-4321 for decision-store infra work.
alex: Thanks all — aim to have spec draft by EOW. :thumbsup:
